name: PAY_AMER_GEOGRAPHIES
description: This table contains North America specific payroll geographies (townships and school districts).

columns.name: PAYROLL_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a geography

columns.name: REFERENCE_TYPE
columns.description: REFERENCE_TYPE

columns.name: REFERENCE_CODE
columns.description: REFERENCE_CODE

columns.name: GEO_CODE
columns.description: Geo Code of the Geography

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of Geography

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_NAME
columns.description: Complete Name of Geography

columns.name: AREA1
columns.description: State Jurisdiction Code

columns.name: AREA2
columns.description: County Jurisdiction Code

columns.name: AREA3
columns.description: City Jurisdiction Code

columns.name: AREA4
columns.description: School District Code

columns.name: LEGISLATION_CODE
columns.description: Code of the country to which the geography belongs

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date from which this geography is valid for use.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which this geography is no longer valid.

columns.name: PRIMARY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicates whether this name is default for this geography

columns.name: PARENT_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Geography Id of County for a geography. Populated only for Townships.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_ENTERPRISES.
